name: Enquiry to signed client
description: From a new enquiry to a signed engagement letter.

sources.title: Interview with Maya Chen, managing director
sources.body:
Interviewer: How long does the first review take?
Maya Chen: About fifteen minutes an enquiry, and I do it the same day.
Interviewer: And proposals?
Maya Chen: Three hours to write, but they sit for a day before I review them. Most of the website enquiries go nowhere, maybe two in three are a fit.
